entry.title: Get a weekly list of newly registered UK food businesses
entry.summary: Use the Food Standards Agency open API to find new UK restaurants, cafes and takeaways each week: a 15-line Python script, or a ready-made Apify Actor.

entry.title: Track Takealot price drops automatically (Python script or ready-made Actor)
entry.summary: Takealot has no price-alert API. Poll its public search endpoint, remember last prices and print only drops: a 20-line Python script, or a scheduled Apify Actor.
